query: SELECT p.id, p.name, GROUP_CONCAT(qq.label) as quantities FROM products p INNER JOIN productQuickQuantities pqq ON p.id = pqq.productId INNER JOIN quickQuantities qq ON pqq.quickQuantityId = qq.id GROUP BY p.id, p.name
